releaseTitle: ATalk v3.15.1 — Document & Media Download Progress, Live Indicators, and HD vs Standard Media Engine
releaseNotes:
• 01 Live Document Download Progress & Time Remaining: Implemented ChatDownloadManager providing real-time streaming download progress for documents and files. Displays animated circular progress ring, completion percentage, downloaded vs total bytes (e.g. 1.8 MB / 3.2 MB), and estimated time remaining (e.g. ~2s left). Includes instant cancel and tap-to-retry capabilities.
• 02 Cloud Document Upload & Storage: Resolved document sharing pipeline to upload file bytes directly to encrypted Supabase cloud storage, generating universal accessible links so recipients can immediately download and open documents in any viewer via FileProvider.
• 03 Visual Photo & Video Loading Rings: Replaced blank black photo/video placeholders with SubcomposeAsyncImage featuring animated circular loading indicators, cloud download status ('Loading photo...', 'Loading HD photo...'), and tap-to-reload fallback states.
• 04 Verified HD vs Standard Media Compression: Audited and perfected the HD media toggle. Standard Quality (Without HD) intelligently downscales high-megapixel camera shots to 1280px max edge at 75% JPEG quality (~150-250 KB) for instantaneous transfers and data conservation. High Definition (HD ON) preserves original camera resolution (up to 4000x3000 / 2560px) with pristine clarity and an explicit cyan [HD] badge.
• 05 Fixed Media Picker HD State Persistence: Fixed HD toggle state assignment in TelegramMediaPickerSheet so selections dynamically switch between HD and Standard without state stickiness.
